capabilities: Draw and edit SCXML and vertep YAML statecharts visually (states, transitions, datamodel, executable content)
Write edits as minimal text patches that preserve comments and keep git diffs small
Validate and simulate charts with the bundled vertep WebAssembly interpreter
Send events with payloads and step through the run watching active configuration and context
Render charts from code blocks and embeds inside notes
extras: Also ships as a VS Code extension and a standalone Electron app. The Obsidian community listing was still pending at 0.1.0, so users must manually download main.js, manifest.json and styles.css into .obsidian/plugins/vertepnyk/. Known limitations include a layout-namespace hash bug in vertep 0.1.3 and automatic layout injection marking fresh charts as modified.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw, edit or run statecharts stored as SCXML or YAML chart files inside the vault.
summary: Visual designer and simulator for vertep statecharts: draw, validate and simulate SCXML and YAML charts, including code blocks and embeds.
